title: biscutella didyma subsp. applanata
intro: Biscutella didyma subsp. applanata, commonly known as the alpine biscutella, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It is a perennial herb native to the mountainous regions of Europe, valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including digestive problems and respiratory infections, due to its therapeutic actions, which include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. Biscutella didyma subsp. applanata contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its health benefits, including antioxidant and antimicrobial activities.
